tools.name: extract_page
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return markdown, metadata and links. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_dns
tools.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, PTR, SRV). Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_whois
tools.description: Domain registration data (registrar, created/expires, status, nameservers) via RDAP. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: IP network owner, range, country and reverse DNS. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_domain_report
tools.description: One-call domain report: registration, DNS, email provider, SPF/DMARC, hosting. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: tools_pdf_text
tools.description: Extract per-page text from a PDF URL (up to 20MB). Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: tools_feed
tools.description: Parse an RSS, Atom or JSON Feed into normalized JSON items. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: tools_sitemap
tools.description: List a site's URLs from its sitemaps (follows robots.txt and sitemap indexes). Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_page, tools_sitemap · Private data: lookup_dns · Public sink: lookup_domain_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_page, tools_sitemap · Private data: lookup_dns · Public sink: lookup_domain_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
